I don’t have web access, so I cannot retrieve live forecasts and therefore cannot determine whether it will rain in Kyoto tomorrow morning (2029-05-15 JST). I did not use any forecast.

Please check an authoritative hourly forecast or radar from one of these sources to verify:

- Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA) — main site and local forecasts: https://www.jma.go.jp/ and English portal https://www.jma.go.jp/jma/indexe.html
- NHK Weather: https://www3.nhk.or.jp/weather/
- Tenki.jp (Weathernews/forecasts for Japan): https://tenki.jp/
- Weathernews: https://weathernews.jp/
- Local prefecture/city websites (Kyoto Prefecture/Kyoto City) for advisories.

How to verify quickly: open one of the sites above, navigate to Kyoto (Kyoto City or Kyoto Prefecture) hourly forecast or radar/nowcast page, and check the probability/amount of precipitation for the morning hours of 2029-05-15.
